name: Lily of the Valley
description: Ethereal white cream cake with hand-crafted sugar lilies and a halo of pearl-white blooms. Timeless. Gorgeous. Will outlast the honeymoon.

name: Autumn Romance
description: Three tiers of fondant magic cascading with orange roses, burgundy blooms and calla lilies. The kind of cake guests photograph before they even say congratulations.

name: Midnight Blossom
description: Three-tier white cake draped in cobalt and cream sugar roses. Dramatic. Stunning. The cake that makes the photographer weep a little.

name: Purple Hydrangea Heaven
description: Three-tier white cake crowned with a lush dome of real purple hydrangeas and blushing roses. Understated luxury — or as understated as purple hydrangeas get.

name: Cascading Rose Dream
description: White fondant blanketed in a waterfall of ivory and blush sugar roses with pearl accents. Genuinely hard to believe this is cake and not sorcery.

name: Sapphire Garden
description: Three tiers drowning in hundreds of hand-crafted royal blue and ivory sugar roses. A glittering garden for your forever day. She made every single one of those roses by hand.

name: Sugar Flower Showcase
description: A close-up of Ingrid's hand-sculpted sugar roses, ranunculus and tropical blooms. Look at these. LOOK AT THEM. All sugar and food coloring. Ingrid made every petal — frankly unbelievable.

name: The Garden Gift Box
description: White striped cylinder with a satin bow, overflowing with fresh roses, strawberries and blooms. Looks like it arrived from a very fancy florist. Tastes better.

name: Grandmère's Garden
description: White cake with blush sugar roses and fresh berries. Elegant, understated, gorgeous. The kind of cake that makes people go quiet for a second before they reach for a fork.

name: Enchanted Meadow
description: Tall white buttercream with hand-piped lavender stems, white daisies and tiny fondant mushrooms. A fairy-tale garden you can eat. No notes.

name: Lavender Rose Garden
description: Two-tier ivory cake with lavender-tinted roses and cherry blossom sprays. Soft, romantic, and genuinely unfair to be this pretty.

name: Midnight Botanical Garden
description: Rich dark chocolate cake ringed with a gorgeous wreath of colorful sugar roses and wildflowers. Proof that chocolate and flowers belong together always.

name: Autumn Ivy
description: Burnished terracotta round cake wrapped in climbing ivy and white roses. Birthday poetry you can eat. For Karen, whoever you are — this one slaps.

name: Wildflower Birthday
description: White cake ringed with a riot of colorful sugar blooms. Roses. Hydrangeas. Wildflowers. Every shade known to human eyes. Happy birthday Amanda.

name: Secret Garden
description: Sage green fondant with cascading sugar roses, forget-me-nots and pearl swag detailing. The fanciest thing Heidi has ever made. She denies this.

name: Chocolate Rose Wreath
description: Dark chocolate cake ringed with a full wreath of buttercream roses in yellow, peach, coral and lavender with little blue forget-me-nots. Looks like a garden, eats like a dream.

name: Pink & White Roses
description: A white cake tumbling with soft pink sugar roses, pearl dots and a chocolate-brown bow.

name: Rock the Dots at 62
description: Indigo cake covered in pastel polka dots with giant number toppers. Turning 62 has literally never looked this cool. This might be the boldest birthday cake she's made. She disagrees.

name: Berry Birthday Bliss
description: Rustic naked layer cake piled high with blackberries, raspberries and blueberries. Effortlessly gorgeous. Like the person turning 58 clearly is.

name: Chocolate Twin Birthday
description: Classic chocolate with a pink rosette border. Simple. Perfect. Shared by Neagan and Triana for their 32nd because some things should be shared.

name: Sunshine & Daisies
description: White cake dotted with cheerful yellow daisy rosettes. Pure joy, condensed into dessert form. Impossible not to smile at this cake.

name: Chocolate & Roses
description: Decadent chocolate cake topped with hot pink sugar roses and bright green leaves. Dark chocolate. Bold flowers. This cake has a personality.

name: Golden Bow Classic
description: Golden yellow cake wrapped in white cream rosettes with a fondant bow on top. The kind of cake a grandmother would make if that grandmother were a brilliant artist.

name: Strawberry Fields Forever
description: White cream cake blanketed in fresh halved strawberries and raspberries. A fruit lover's dream. Also for anyone who wants to feel like they're being healthy while eating cake.

name: Happy Birthday Karen
description: A giant '59' scattered with blue sugar blossoms and ringed by a small forest of candles for Karen's birthday.

name: Quack Attack
description: Donald Duck's iconic face sculpted in white and yellow buttercream. His expression is perfect. He looks exactly like he always does — furious, but lovable.

name: Angry and Delicious
description: The Red Angry Bird himself — round, bold, absolutely fuming — with the whole flock around him. Kids lose their minds. Adults also lose their minds.

name: I'm Ready, I'm Ready!
description: SpongeBob in full birthday mode on a sheet cake. Joseph's face when he saw this was reportedly priceless. The cake was also reportedly gone in twelve minutes.

name: Wild Thing
description: Two-tier safari cake: zebra print sides, jungle animals peeking over the top. Christopher apparently did not want to cut it. Christopher had good taste.

name: I Love You, You Love Cake
description: Barney the purple dinosaur towering over his own two-tier birthday garden. Caylee is turning 2. This cake is going to be the main memory of her childhood. That's fine.

name: Fairy Hollow
description: Green fondant cake with a garden fairy, pink mushrooms and butterflies. Every little dreamer's birthday wish, made edible. The kid who got this cake is still talking about it.

name: All Aboard the Birthday Express!
description: Thomas the Tank Engine bursting out of a stone fondant tunnel on a two-tier birthday cake. Ian is turning 2. Ian will remember this. Ian's parents will also remember this.

name: Here Be Dragons
description: A towering castle guarded by a fierce red dragon on blue cobblestones. Made for Nicky in 2011 and honestly still one of the most impressive cakes in the archive. Happy birthday, wherever you are.

name: Mud, Bikes & Birthday!
description: Muddy terrain cake with a toy ATV and dirt bike. David is turning 2. David has very good birthday cake taste for a two year old.

name: Sk8ter Bday
description: A black skateboard with raging red and orange flames for Anthony's birthday. Rad. Absolutely rad. Even comes with a "No Skateboarding on Public Roadways" sign, which is commitment to the bit.

name: Piggies in the Chocolate Mud
description: Kit Kat fence, fondant piglets wallowing in chocolate mud pool, HAPPY BIRTHDAY candles. The fanciest French bakery you know. Oink.

name: Adventure Time, Kevin!
description: Aqua-blue quarter sheet loaded with Finn, Jake, the Ice King and Gunter the penguin for Kevin's birthday. Algebraic. The candles barely fit.

name: Snidely Whiplash
description: The top-hatted, mustache-twirling cartoon villain himself, hand-painted on a fondant panel against a sunset-orange sky. Curses! Foiled again — it's delicious.

name: Ingrid's Dragon
description: An enormous serpentine dragon — red and blue scales, a hand-sculpted head, the whole nine yards — coiled across the table. Ingrid built this entire showpiece solo, every scale by hand. Yes, all of it.

name: Born to Be Wild
description: Two-tier Harley-Davidson birthday cake. Chrome bikes, flames, the iconic bar-and-shield. Built for someone who knows exactly who they are.

name: Road King at 50
description: Black flame-licked motorcycle cake with a Harley road king on top and golden 50 candles. Half a century of being awesome. The cake knew it.

name: Stratocaster Sweet
description: A full-sized blue Fender Stratocaster. Made of cake. For a rock star's birthday. This is the most Heidi cake in the entire collection.

name: Drop the Beat
description: A snare drum with fondant tension rods and actual drumsticks resting on top. So realistic people have tried to play it. (Don't play it. It's cake.)

name: Play It Again, Eddie
description: Black-and-white music birthday cake with treble clef, musical notes and a "37" fondant topper. For Eddie. The musical kind. There's also an Eddie cake elsewhere on this site that's a very different vibe.

name: Born to Ride
description: Three massive dirt bike tires stacked up, topped with a Honda CRF420 tearing through the mud. For a dirt bike person's birthday. This cake goes zero to sixty.

name: Super Bowl Sunday
description: Full-size football field sheet cake with team helmets and goalposts. The real MVP at any game day party. Eat the losing team's endzone first.

name: Silver & Black Attack
description: All-black Raiders cake with the iconic shield. Just win, baby. Then eat the cake, also baby.

name: Level Up
description: An Xbox 360 controller in fondant for Kevin's 16th. The buttons work aesthetically. They do not actually work. This was confirmed.

name: Game of Cakes
description: Fantasy gaming birthday cake with a dragon, Groot, movie prop glasses and rainbow candles. Someone described this as "maximalist." They meant it as a compliment.

name: Gearhead, Happy 21st
description: A gear-shaped black cake with a gleaming fondant wrench stamped "GEARHEAD." For the car person who has everything. Except this cake.

name: End of the Rainbow
description: Ganache-covered cake overflowing with gold coins, shamrocks and leprechaun hats for St. Patrick's Day. You didn't think there'd be a pot-of-gold cake on here? You clearly haven't been paying attention.

name: Betty Goes Rogue
description: Betty Boop reclining in chocolate with red roses. Sassy. Sculpted. A masterpiece. Betty would be honored. Betty would also probably want a slice.

name: The Fat Rat
description: An absolutely tubby fondant rat lounging next to a wedge of cheese. Content. Living his best life. A spirit animal for all of us, really.

name: Say Cheese!
description: A hilariously realistic set of fondant dentures on a purple velvet base. For a dentist's retirement. Or for someone with a very good sense of humor. Both, ideally.

name: The Best Steak You'll Never Eat
description: A steak. Corn. Mashed potatoes. Carrots. On a plate. Made entirely of cake. For Jericho's birthday. Jericho has phenomenal taste in birthday cakes. The steak looks medium-rare.

name: Dark & Dangerous at 47
description: Black fondant cake with sculpted orange and gold flames. Moody. Bold. Magnificent. Forty-seven never looked this threatening. Meant as a compliment.

name: Skull & Roses
description: Red two-tier cake encrusted with dozens of sculpted skulls, roses and gold crowns. HAPPY BIRTHDAY. Gloriously macabre. Exactly the kind of cake this bakery exists to make.

name: Gold Skull, 48 Candles
description: A gold metallic life-size human skull cake with a snake, calla lilies and the number 48. Stunningly bizarre. Technically one of the most beautiful cakes here. Yes, really.

name: Doctor, Doctor!
description: A doctor's coat, stethoscope, clipboard and prescription pad — all in fondant. Take two slices and call me in the morning. If you eat the whole thing you might actually need the doctor.

name: Cheeky Birthday Surprise 🔞
description: A sculpted fondant torso cake for Eddie's birthday. Adults only. This was requested. Heidi delivered. She always delivers.

name: Happy Birthday Dude! 🔞
description: A leaf-shaped birthday cake with a very specific leaf in mind. Adults only. Happy Birthday, Dude. You know what you ordered.

name: Cloud Nine 🔞
description: Pink birthday cake with a full hookah centerpiece in red and gold. Adults only. For the free spirits. For the bold souls. For the people who knew exactly what they wanted their birthday cake to look like.

name: Yin & Yang Dragons
description: A white fondant round with two dragons locked in a blue-and-black yin-yang, hand-piped right down to the scales. For Nicky. Black candles, naturally.

name: Bullseye
description: A regulation dartboard rendered in cake, right down to the red and green wedges. Closest slice to the bull buys the next round.

name: Happy Birthday, JJ 🔞
description: A sculpted torso cake with a Happy Birthday sash and a 'JJ' monogram. Adults only. Requested, delivered, no further questions.

name: The Bat-Signal
description: The Batman emblem in glossy black on a bright yellow oval. Simple, iconic, and exactly what Gotham ordered.

name: Edible Fruit Bouquet
description: A bouquet built entirely from fresh fruit — melon balls, strawberries, grapes and star-cut pineapple. Not technically a cake, but a showstopper all the same.

name: Orioles Birthday, Donnie
description: A Baltimore Orioles jersey cake on a green field with the bird mascot perched on top. Happy birthday, Donnie — and let's go O's.

name: Calla Lily Elegance
description: White sheet cake with corner bouquets of calla lilies and sunset roses. Clean. Classy. Exactly what "simple sophistication" actually looks like.

name: Simply Fabulous
description: White sheet cake with a blue rosette border and elegant script for Sam's 34th. Classic. Crowd-pleasing. Gone in twenty minutes at any party.

name: Stork Has Landed!
description: White baby shower cake with ABC blocks and a stork topper for Baby Michael. Classic. Sweet. The stork looks like it knows something we don't.

name: Finally Retiring!
description: Cream sheet cake with vine-and-rose scrollwork. "Congratulations on your Retirement." You made it. Now eat cake. You've earned it.

name: Happy Birthday Cindy
description: Soft pink sheet cake with trailing green vines and tiny blue blossoms in the corners. Simple, pretty, and gone by the end of the party.

name: Sweet Pink Baby Shower
description: Three-tier pink baby shower cake with gold lettering, blocks and ribbon bows. Pink perfection for a new arrival. Someone ate the whole middle tier at the shower. No names.

name: Welcome to the World, Hank!
description: Baby blue round cake with fondant booties and silver ribbon. The world got a Hank. Hank got a very good cake to mark the occasion. Fair trade.

name: You Made It, Marilyn!
description: White two-tier graduation cake with mortarboard topper for the class of 2015. YOU MADE IT. Heidi made this. Everyone wins in this scenario.

name: Forever in Our Hearts
description: A tribute sheet cake with hand-piped roses for Eddie John Motley, 1986–2022. "Forever in our hearts." Heidi made this with love. That's what she does.

name: Frosty Says Hello
description: Two-tier snowman cake with a top hat, red striped scarf, twig arms and a "Season's Greetings" sign. You will feel terrible cutting into this. Cut into it anyway. It's delicious.

name: Christmas Cookie Factory
description: Santas, trees, holly wreaths, bells — all impeccably decorated. Santa has seen this. Santa gave it five stars. Santa asked if he could place an order.

name: Santa's Little Helpers
description: Rows of buttercream Santa cookies with jolly faces, belts and holly. Almost too cute to eat. Not quite. Still ate them.

name: 12 Days of Cookies
description: Snowmen, wreaths, Santas, candy canes, trees — a full Christmas cookie collection. Order in early November. She is not kidding about this.

name: Holiday Cookie Spread
description: Trees, stockings, Santa-clad cookies beautifully iced for the holiday table. Nobody leaves empty-handed. Nobody leaves without eating four.

name: Stars & Snowflakes
description: Star and snowflake sugar cookies in red, green and white. Perfect for gifting. Perfect for eating alone with a cup of tea. Perfect, period.

name: Santa Hat Parade
description: Santa hats, candy canes and gingerbread men in formation. Pure holiday magic. Your kids will ask for these every year. Plan accordingly.

name: Snowflake Season
description: Large snowflake sugar cookies alongside Christmas house cookies. Iced to absolute perfection. A winter wonderland on a plate. Order early. Everyone wants these.

name: The Cupcake Bouquet
description: Cupcakes piped to look like roses, chrysanthemums and dahlias, arranged like a florist's bouquet in a gift box. A bouquet you can eat. Heidi's big heart in dessert form.

name: Boo Crew Cupcakes
description: Chocolate cupcakes with fondant ghosts and jack-o-lanterns. Trick or treat yourself. These disappear at Halloween parties at a rate that can only be described as supernatural.

name: Purple Rain Cupcake Collection
description: A dozen cupcakes with swirling purple, teal and white buttercream rosettes scattered with pearl sprinkles. One dozen reasons to be happy. Order two dozen to be sure.
